summary: Mrs. Hidary explores the journey of Avraham Abinu in Parashat Lech Lecha, framing it as a movement from intellect to emotion and from the familiar to the unknown. She highlights the role of Sarah as an unencumbered partner in this process and discusses the significance of the Brit Milah and the promise of Yitzhak. The class emphasizes the importance of stepping outside one's comfort zone to connect with Hashem and develop true emunah.
questions: Why did Hashem tell Avraham to leave his home and family?
What is the significance of the name change from Avram to Avraham?
How does the story of Sarah being an akarah frame the entire Parasha?
Why is it important to balance intellect with emotion in our service of Hashem?
What does it mean to be tamim?
